tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bag ma la dge ba'i las phran bdun gyi cho ga bkra shis dpal skyed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo mañdzu shrī ya/ 'jig rten pa'i srid 'dzin pa la bag ma len pa'i cho ga zhes 'phags yul du rig byed lugs dang*/ rgya nag 'byung rtsis las ci rigs pa 'byung yang*/ so so'i yul lugs 'dod sbyar lta bus gzhung gzhan ltar khrigs su sbyar ba med stabs/ yig rnying phal cher grong sngags pa mi mkhas pas bcos pas tshul dang mthun pa mi snang bas/ 'dir bag ma la dge ba'i las phran bdun ces grags pa de nyid skabs su babs shing 'thad pa'i phyogs su bzung nas khrigs su bkod pa la/ thog mar sna bon bskyed rim lha sngags kyi gding dang ldan cing nus pa thob pa/ bag ma'i bdun zur lo pa zhig gis bya ba 'byung rtsis kyi dgongs pa yin la/ yo byad drag sngags kyis btab pa'i thun dang rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs bskyed bzlas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i khrus chu me long*/ sna 'dre skrod pa'i rdzas stag yos lo pa la lcags kyi ral gri/ rta sbrul la chu skyog nag po/ bya sprel la me sgron/ byi lug la sa ser/ gshed bzhi lo pa la tsher ma can gyi shing gi yal ga sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams rtsis gzhung dang*/ yul lugs bstun te 'du bya/ de nas bag mas khang mgo mthong sar sleb ma thag glang chen sna bsgyur gyi gto bca' sgrub byas pa bor/ dngos gzhi las phran bdun ni/ sna 'dre bskrad pa/ mnol grib bkru ba/ gdan bting ba/ dkar gsum gyis ngo gso ba/ ming 'dogs pa/ lha la 'dogs pa/ g.yang 'gugs pa rnams dang*/ mtha' rten shis pa brjod pa'o/ ༈ /dang po bag sna la 'dre yod pas de bskrad pa ni/ sgo rtsar slebs pa dang*/ sngags 'chang gis thun dang dgra gshed kyi rdzas thogs la/ yi dam gang rung gi nga rgyal bzung dgos kyang*/ 'dir spyi tsam du/ oṃ ā kro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam dpal nag po rab tu khros pa'i skur gyur/ hūm̐ hrīḥ

/bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu stobs kyis// dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs// log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas rnam par dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa zhi ba dang khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal ldan dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes dang las dang 'jig rten pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bag sna la rgyu ba'i 'byung po gdon gyi rigs su gyur cing gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor dang ldan pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /gal te bden pa'i bka' thos bzhin tu 'gro bar mi byed pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i khro bo dang mtshon cha'i char chen pos rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur ro// aye ring sogs drag sngags gang shes dang*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wā na bidya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ brjod la thun gtor/ de nas dgra gshed kyi rdzas thogs la/ hūm̐/ nga ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal te// 'byung ba lnga las gyur pa yi// 'dre gdon 'byung po yid gzugs can// bag ma'i sna la rgyu ba kun// gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor rab tu spongs// 'byung ba lnga yi dbyings su dengs// ye shes lnga yi rang rtsal las// rten 'brel rdzas su shar ba 'di// 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su gnang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs// ting 'dzin sngags kyi nus mthu bskyed// phyar ba tsam gyis kun kyang 'dar// brabs pa tsam gyis 'dre gdon zhi// snang srid gdug rtsub zhi bar nus// shing gi gnod pa dar ba na// gnam lcags ral gri 'bar bas bcad// me yi gnod pa dar ba na// chu rgyun rba rlabs 'khrugs bas bsang*// lcags kyi gnod pa dar ba na// me dpung rab tu 'bar bas bzhu// chu yi gnod pa dar ba na// g.yo med sa yi phung pos bsub// sa yi gnod pa dar ba na// ljon shing yal ga rgyas pas bshig

/'byung lnga'i lha 'dre gnod sems can// thams cad rang dgra'i nus pas bcom// 'phags pa 'jam dpal bden pa dang*// rten 'brel rdzas gyi nus pa yis// 'byung lnga'i sna 'dre zhi gyur cig /oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur mi sod/ dur rta sod/ chu kha la mgo la sod/ gnyan mgo la chong*/ kha la dzaḥkaṃ shaṃ traṃ rbang phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la ral gri yin na g.yug /chu 'thor sogs bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa bag ma la khyim lha sogs mnol ba'i grib yod pas de bkru ba ni/ sngar bsgrubs pa'i khrus chu dang me long thogs la/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs sngags la/ e ho shuddhe shuddhe/ yaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ baṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ laṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ shuddhe shuddhe swā hā/ btags la khrus bya ba phyin chad 'gre'o// 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhiṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin= 'chal ba'i dri ma= tshul khrims nyid la= tshul khrims chu yis= khrus legs mdzad kyis= sngags sngar ltar brjod pa 'gre/ 'di ni bzod pa'i= khang khro'i dri ma sbyang mdzad= bzod pa nyid la= bzod pa'i chu yis= khrus legs mdzad kyis= sngags brjod/ 'di ni brtson 'grus= le lo'i dri ma= brtson 'grus nyid la legs 'god= brtson 'grus chu yis= khrus legs mdzad kyis= sngags dang*/ 'di ni bsam gtan= g.yeng ba'i dri ma= bsam gtan nyid la= bsam gtan chu yis= khrus legs mdzad kyis= sngags dang*/ 'di ni shes rab= gti mug dri ma: shes rab nyid la= shes rab chu yis= khrus legs mdzad kyis=

sngags dang*/ hūm̐/ rnam par 'joms pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ sme ba brtsegs pa'i nus mthu dang*// gsang sngags rigs sngags bden pa yis// bkru'o sdig sgrib thams cad bkru// bkru'o nad gdon bgegs rigs bkru// byur dang skal pa ngan pa dang*// bkra mi shis pa thams cad bkru// phyogs ngan 'dre lnga bdud gcod dang*// mi gtsang mnol grib phog pa bkru// zas ngan lto ru zos pa dang*// gos ngan lus la gyon pa bkru// rgab 'dre yul 'dri 'khyams po dang*// dam sri dkor 'dre'i gnod pa bkru// shi 'dre mo dang gson 'dre mo// bse rag 'gong po'i kha rlangs bkru// pha rol byad kha rbod gtong dang*// byol po chags che'i gnod pa bkru// pha lha ma lha zhang lha dang*// phrag lha yul lha mnol ba bkru// pha mtshun dgra bla gnyan po dang*// skyob byed lha srung mnol ba bkru// mkhon dang btsog gis mnol ba bkru// dme dang yug gis mnol ba bkru// 'byung lnga'i gdon gyis mnol ba bkru// gangs ri bzhin du dkar gyur cig /shel dkar bzhin du gsal gyur cig /bkra shis bde legs rgyas gyur cig / sngags brjod/ stong gsum kun tu dri dang ngad ldan pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang dag pa'i khrus// ye shes sprin phung mkha' la char 'bebs pas// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs kun dag gyur cig /oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a byi la maṇḍa la ma ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ma ka ra ka ra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ma khaṃ khaṃ ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ma raṃ raṃ ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ma su su staṃ staṃ ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ma sngo ta sngo ta ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba dat/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā di mahā shra ma ṇa swāhā brjod la khrus bya'o/ ༈ gsum pa khyim nang du bag ma'i srog lus dbang klung bskyed pa'i gdan gang dgos rtsis gzhung dang mthun par bting ba'i steng du kha sme ba dkar gsum mam/

phywa lon sogs kyi phyogs su bstan te bzhag la/ kye/ bkra shis srid pa dang po la// bod khams kha ba can ljongs su// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid// mi yi rje bo'i tshul bstan pa// chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po des// 'jig rten mthun 'jug mdzad pa dang*// gdul bya smin cing grol ba'i phyir// 'phrul blon chen po mgar la sogs// gnyen po rkya brgya bcas pa rnams// rgya dang bal po'i yul du btang*// khro gnyer can ma'i rnam 'phrul ni// bal rje'i sras mo khri btsun dang*// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rnam 'phrul ni// lha gcig 'un shing kong jo gnyis// 'dzam bu'i gling na dkon pa yi// khyad par 'phags pa'i rten mchog dang*// rin thang med pa'i nor bu'i rigs// dar zab gos kyi bye brag sogs// bod khams 'tshing ba'i brdzang ba bcas// bar chad med par spyan drangs te// bod yul dbus su gdan phab pas// rgyal blon rnams kyi bsam pa 'grub// chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor dang*// bkra shis bde legs phywa g.yang gis// bod khams mtha' dbus kun tu gong*// bde skyid dbyar mtsho bzhin tu rgyas// dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel// sngon gyi srid pa de bzhin du// de ring rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gis// dpal 'byor dbang thang 'phel ba'i phyir// rigs bzang khungs btsun skyon dang bral// yon tan tshang ba'i bu mo bkug /bkra shis lha yi khyim 'di ru// phun tshogs brtan pa'i gdan cig bting*// lha mi gnyis ka gdan la bzhugs// za 'og dar dkar gdan steng du// dgra bla rnams kyi bzhugs gnas mdzod// za 'og dar ser gdan steng du// pho lha rnams kyi bzhugs gnas mdzod// za 'og dar dmar gdan steng du// ma lha rnams kyi bzhugs gnas mdzod// za 'og dar ljang gdan steng du// zhang lha rnams kyi bzhugs gnas mdzod// za 'og dar sngon gdan steng du// yul lha rnams kyi bzhugs gnas mdzod// bkra shis kha tag yug ring la// skyob pa'i lha rnams bzhugs gnas mdzod// mi 'gyur rdo rje rgya gram gdan// srog la dgra dar nyes pa skyobs// lo brgya dag tu 'tsho bar shog

/dbang sgyur 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gdan// lus la dgra dar nyes pa srungs// nad med lang tsho dar bar shog /bkra shis g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i gdan// dbang thang dgra dar nyes pa skyobs// bu nor chos gsum 'dzom par shog /rab mdzes padma 'dab brgyad gdan// klung gta' dgra dar nyes pa srungs// ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub par shog /dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum po dang*// chos srung yul lha gzhi bdag dang*// 'go ba'i lha lnga skyobs byed dgu// pha mtshun dgra bla'i tshogs rnams kyis// nyin dang mtshan tu mi g.yel bar// rtag tu srung skyobs sdong grogs mdzod// tshe srog brtan cing dbang thang 'phel// bkra shis bde legs rab rgyas shog ༈ / bzhi pa mthun gsum lo ma bkra shis pa'i bu mo'am khye'u la dkar gsum gyi bza' btung khem dang bcas pa bzung bcol zhing lan gsum phyis la/ kye/ rin po che las grub pa'i khem// lag tu blangs te lan gsum phyi// lha mi rnams kyi ngo sogs la// shel las gsal la dung las dkar// mi gtsang bar chad med pa yi// rten 'brel lhun gyis grub par shog / dkar gsum skyems phud mchod la/ kye/ skyabs gnas mgon byed lha rnams mchod// pha lha ma lha zhang lha mchod// srog lha dgra lha khyim lha mchod// thab lha zas lha yul lha mchod// bkra shis bde skyid dngos grub stsol// dkar gsum dang 'o zho'i skyems drangs la/ kye/ yon tan brgya ldan bdud rtsi'i bcud// lha rnams kun gyi dngos grub yin// mi rnams 'tsho ba'i zas mchog yin// dgos 'dod kun 'byung g.yang gi bcud// rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i zas// zas mchog 'di la longs spyod pas// lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong*// bde skyid lha dang mnyam par shog /'dzad med nor gyis phyugs par shog /zas med zas dang ldan par shog /bsod nams longs spyod phun sum tshogs// thams cad brten pa'i gzhir gyur cig

༈ / lnga pa go sa sogs dang mthun cing bkra shis rigs brgyud 'phel ba'i ming 'dogs pa ni/ kye/ de ring gnam la gza' skar bzang*// sa la dus tshod dag kyang bzang*// bar la rten 'brel la nye bzang*// bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i gnas skabs 'dir// 'dre srin byur gsum mar la bkar// mgon skyabs lha srung yar la bstod// nam mkhar lha yi 'ja' sprin 'thibs// sa gzhir mi yi me tog bkra// bar du bkra shis char pa 'bebs// bdag la brten pa'i bsrung bya bar// bkra shis phun tshogs ming zhig btags// ming du btags par ma mdzad na// 'jig rten thams cad rmongs par gyur// de bas rmongs pa bsal ba'i phyir// mgon pos ming du btags par mdzad// srung dang skyabs kyi ming btags pas// dkon mchog gsum gyis skyob par shog /mgon dang srung gi ming btags pas// lha srung gnyan pos mgon byed shog /'tsho ba'i ming mtha' ldan pa yis// lo brgya dag kyang 'tsho bar shog /nam mkha'i ming las gras pa yis// dbu 'phang dgung bas mtho bar shog /sa gzhi'i ming las gras pa yis// sa bzhin yon tan kun skyed shog /ri bo'i ming las gras pa yis// dbang thang ri ltar brtan par shog /nyi zla'i ming las gras pa yi// nyi zla bzhin tu kun snang shog /rten 'brel phun tshogs ming btags pas// bu nor chos gsum 'dzom pa dang*// skyid dga' mtha' ru phyin par shog /dpal dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang*// bkra shis don rnams 'grub par shog /grags pa bzang po bkra shis ming*// bod khams kun tu snyan par grags// lha mi yongs kyis smon pa yi// bde legs dpal du 'bar gyur cig / ces shis brjod dang bcas te rgyal po sogs chen po'i rigs la/ sa spyod dbang mo/ bkra shis dang bde legs dang*/ phun tshogs dbang mo sogs dang*/ phal pa la tshod dang mthun pa'i ming bkra legs pa gdags par bya'o/ ༈ drug pa lha la 'dogs pa ni/ lha rten gyi mda' dar ram/

tshe bum sogs thogs la/ hoḥ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// chos skyong srung ma khyad par sbyin bdag 'dis// pha mes dus nas brten sgrub mchod pa'i lha// thams cad de ring gsan cing dgongs su gsol// rigs bzang yon tan ldan pa'i mo btsun 'di// deng nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar// ye shes spyan ldan skyabs gnas khyed rnams la// skyabs su gsol zhing sgo gsum 'bul lags na// thugs rje brtse bas dgongs te rjes su zung*// skyabs 'og chud cing byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud// gang zag snyan brgyud las 'phro gter gyi brgyud// bshad brgyud sgrub brgyud don brgyud 'dzin pa yi// rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// rigs kyi bu mo 'di yi lus ngag yid// srung zhing skyobs la byin gyis rlobs par mdzad// theg pa rim pa dgu yi lha rnams dang*// bya rgyud spyod brgyud rnal 'byor bla na med// rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam lha yi tshogs// rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs kyis// rigs kyi bu mo 'di yi lus ngag yid// srung zhing skyobs la byin gyis rlobs par mdzod// rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang*// gsang ba ye shes seng ge'i gdong pa can// sgrol ma dkar sngon khro gnyer can ma sogs// ri rab rdul mnyam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis// rigs kyi bu mo= /srung zhing = /ma mgon lcam dral dpal mgon bdun cu lnga// a phyi mched lnga tshe ring mched lnga dang*// rdo rje g.yu sgron brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs// ye shes las dang 'jig rten chos skyong gis// rigs kyi bu mo 'di yi lus ngag yid// srung zhing skyobs la byin gyis rlobs par mdzod//

'dir rang rang gi chos skyong sogs sbyor dgos pas skabs 'dir mtshon na/ khyad par nag po chen po rdo rje gur// lcam dral lha brgyad bka' 'khor bcas pa dang*// zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po zhal bzhi pa// beg rtse lcam dral dur khrod bdag po sogs// brgyud srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis// rigs kyi bu mo= /srung zhing = /rgyal chen rnam sras yum mchog dpal lha mo// dzaṃ lha dkar ser dmar nag nor gyi rgyun// rig byed ma sogs nor lha gter bdag dang*/ khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i lha rnams kyis// rigs kyi bu= /srung zhing = /khyad par 'phags ma so so 'brang ma dang*// bsil ba'i tshal dang gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin// rma bya chen mo stong chen rab 'joms sogs// gzungs rig lha dang phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams kyis// rigs kyi bu mo= /srung zhing = /pha lha ma lha zhang lha dgra bla dang*// yul lha khyim lha dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha// mi'u gdung drug rus chen sde lnga la// mgon skyabs byed pa'i so so'i lha rnams dang*// bden tshig smon lam grub pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// rigs kyi= /srung zhing = / 'dir so so'i yul lha skabs thob 'dzud dgos pas skabs 'dir mtshon na/ dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje g.yung drung rtsal// rdo rje blo gros rdo rje thog sras dang*// rdo rje dgra 'dul rdo rje gzhon nu sogs// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul gzhi gnas bdag gis// rigs kyi bu mo= /srung zhing skyobs la= /pha myes brgyud srung mgon byed lha srung rnams// gzhi byes nyin dang mtshan mo dus rtag tu// lus dang grib ma ji bzhin skad cig kyang*// 'bral ba med par srung zhing bskyab tu gsol/ kye/ dbus nas mgon lha dkar pos srungs// steng nas nam mkha'i lha mos srungs// 'og nas sa yi lha mos srungs// g.yas nas pho lha gnyan pos srungs// g.yon nas ma lha bu rdzis srungs// rgyab nas dgra bla dar mas srungs// mdun nas zhang lha srog lhas srungs// phug lha gnyen pos srung skyobs mdzod// de ring mi nor brgya btang yang*// sang nyin stong phrag tshur la shog

/nor lha gnyen pos srung skyobs mdzod// de ring phyugs brgya phar btang yang*// sang nyin phyugs stong tshur la shog /zas lha gnyen pos srung skyobs mdzod// de ring zas brgya phar byin kyang*// sang nyin zas stong tshur la shog /rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// dkon mchog bden pa'i nus mthu yis// de ring nyi ma phyin chad nas// mi dang lha gnyis ma 'bral bar// rtag tu srung zhing skyob par shog /lus la na tsha med par shog /tshe la bar chad med par shog /srog la shi chad med par shog /mnga' thang rigs brgyud 'phel bar shog /gnas la bkra shis brtan par shog /yul la 'pho 'chug med par shog /sa la brtan phur tshugs par shog /mi 'phen rta hrag 'dzom par shog /phyug gi gter kha brdol bar shog /skyid dga' yun ring gnas par shog /dbang thang dgung dang mnyam par shog /phug gi lha yis skyob par shog /bar gyi mi dang mthun par shog /mi tshe skyid kyis 'khyol bar shog /mthun gsum 'grogs yun ring bar shog /sman 'dzang dbang bu tshang bar shog /snyan grags 'brug ltar khyab par shog /dge ba'i sa bon 'debs par shog /bu nor chos gsum 'dzom par shog /bde skyid longs spyod ldan par shog /ci bsam don kun 'grub par shog ༈ / bdun pa g.yang 'gugs pa ni mda' dar g.yab la/ kye/ de ring srid pa'i gnam gang la// khyim 'dzin 'di la rten btsugs nas// phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad phywa g.yang bkug /dkon mchog rtsa gsum byin rlabs dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags nus mthu dang*// bden pa grub pa'i bden mthu dang*// rten 'brel rdzas kyi nus pa yis// steng phyogs lha yi phywa g.yang khug /'og phyogs klu yi phywa= /bar phyogs gnyan gyi= /gling bzhi mi yi= /lha srin sde brgyad phya= /rgya gar dam pa'i chos g.yang khug /rgya nag btsan brjid khrims g.yang khug /stag gzig nor gyi phyug g.yang khug /zas nor gos kyi bcud g.yang khug /bde skyid dpal 'byor phywa g.yang khug

/dbu nag mi yi phywa= /gser dngul nor gyi= /dar zab gos kyi phywa= /rkang bzhi phyugs kyi phywa= /bza' btung bcud kyi phywa= /tshe ring nad med phywa= /ci bsam 'grub pa'i= /phun tshogs dge legs g.yang khug cig/ kye/ mi tshur 'ong rjes la mi g.yang shog /nor tshur 'ong rjes la nor g.yang shog /zas tshur 'ong rjes la zas g.yang shog /bag ma tshur 'ong rjes la dpal g.yang shog /yo ma tshur 'ong rjes la rta g.yang shog /gnag phyugs tshur 'ong rjes la zog g.yang shog /g.yang dkar tshur 'ong rjes la lug g.yang shog /tshe tshe tshur 'ong rjes la ra g.yang shog /lho sprin 'dra ba'i nor g.yang shog /sa gzhi 'dra ba'i 'bru g.yang shog /sbrang char 'dra ba'i zas g.yang shog /rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i 'o g.yang shog /nags tshal 'dra ba'i gos g.yang shog /btsan po rnams kyi btsan g.yang shog /phyug po rnams kyi phyug g.yang shog /'phen po rnams kyi 'phen g.yang shog /g.yang la g.yang 'phel gter gyi g.yang*// khyim la g.yang 'phel mi yi g.yang*// bang mdzod g.yang 'phel nor gyi g.yang*// zhing la g.yang 'phel 'bru yi g.yang*// ra bar g.yang 'phel phyugs kyi g.yang*// zas la g.yang 'phel bcud kyi g.yang*// dgos rgu ma tshang med pa'i g.yang*// dge legs lhun gyis grub pa'i g.yang*// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i g.yang*// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi phywa g.yang rnams// de ring lha khyim 'di ru len// g.yang gi ra ba 'di la bsdu// dpal gyi mi mo 'di la bstims// mi nyams mi 'thor bcud du 'khyil// phya tshe g.yang gi dngos grub rnams// lho sprin bzhin du 'thibs par shog /sbrang char bzhin tu 'bebs par shog /rgya mtsho bzhin tu 'khyil bar shog /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin chad med shog /lhun po bzhin tu brtan par shog /btsan phyug 'phen dar 'dzom pa dang*// bkra shis bde legs ldan par shog ༈ / brgyad pa mtha' rten bkra shis brjod pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa lha dang drang srong bden pa grub pa rnams dang dkar po'i phyogs skyong ba rnams dang bcas pas bkra shis pa'i bden tshig brjod cing me tog char du bsnyil bar gyur/

phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas padma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ ༈ /gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la= ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang zhig bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed la= skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des// khyed la= gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la= gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la// gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la= dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pas// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la= gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la= byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la=

chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed la= yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la= sangs rgyas khyod la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog ༈ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*// 'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog ༈ /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*// brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*// snyan grags nam mkha' lta bur khyab gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog ༈ /lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog ༈ /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims srung ba dang*// bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa yis// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog / sogs bkra shis kyi tshig phreng rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa brjod cing me tog 'thor/ slar yang*/ nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin// rgyu skar thams cad bzang po yin// sangs rgyas rnams ni rdzu 'phrul che// dgra bcom rnams ni zag pa zad// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di yi mthus// bdag cag rtag tu bde legs shing*// ji ltar smon pa kun 'grub shog

/maṅga laṃ siddhi dza ya a la la hoḥ zhes bden pa'i tshig gi mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ de ltar las phran bdun po mtha' brten dang bcas pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lag len 'grigs chags su bkod pa 'di'ang*/ sde bzhi dge ba bcu dang ldan pa'i rgyal khab chen por lung zin sprul pa'i chos rgyal rin po che'i srid 'dzin tu/ stag lung gzi'i gdung rigs kyi btsun mo dam pa pheb pa'i tshe nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te/ lha shes su rloms pa'i sngags rig 'dzin pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos lcang ra 'chi med lha klu'i dga' tshal du bris pa dge legs 'phel/ maṅga laṃ/// /
